appended_meaning:
The complete eleven-reference health-conditions chain is now traced to the original application/conforming clauses at their exact selected extents. This is an exact reference-mechanism reconstruction, not full underlying-condition or individual medical application. Current 3014(h)(4)'s continuing direction remains alongside each source's printed fiscal-year, period or amendment-appropriation scope. Older dates are not silently removed, deemed automatic repeal, shifted to a new partial-year grant minimum or imported as new H.R. 1968 money.

Original PL114-10 221(c) makes amounts appropriated by that section for FY2016 and FY2017 subject to PL113-235 requirements for funds for PHSA 330-340 programs. Original PL115-123 50901(e) retains FY2018 or FY2019 amounts and PL115-31 requirements for the same program range. Its complete (f) replaces the earlier CHIP-funding-extension reference with 50901(e); that historical replacement directive is not an additional current h4 authority. The surrounding old CHC program/amendment/appropriation text is not applied to current victim-service grants.

The four subsequent selected application clauses name PL116-94 requirements for PHSA 330-340 program funds. Original CARES 3831(d) retains FY2020 and October 1-November 30, 2020; its (e) replaces the earlier division N 401(d) reference with section 3831. Original PL116-159 2101(d) retains October 1 through December 11, 2020; its complete conforming amendment adds the printed whole-section 2101 identity alongside 3831. Original PL116-215 1201(d) retains December 11-18, 2020 and its (e) adds that (d) identity. Original PL116-260 division BB 301(d) retains FY2021-2023 and its (e) adds the exact division BB 301(d). The printed touching/overlapping December 11 boundaries and whole-section versus subsection reference forms are preserved without repair or an invented current funds total. These four original conditions references are not assumed to point only to PL117-328 or to have become new EH appropriations.

The five later original application clauses point to PL117-328 requirements for funds for PHSA 330-340 programs: PL118-15 2321(d), PL118-22 201(d), PL118-35 101(d), PL118-42 division G 101(d), and PL118-158 3101(d). Each selected (d) applies to amounts appropriated pursuant to the amendments made by that section; no additional fiscal-year restriction is inserted into these (d) clauses. Their complete same-section conforming directives preserve the accumulating reference identities, including the earlier unqualified 'Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024' name and the already bound original 3101(e) division-G clarification. Literal source punctuation and earlier repair directives remain, without silently repairing governed bytes or recreating retired references as extra current authorities.

The already bound exact voted EH 2101(d)/(e) supplies an additional PL117-328/PHSA 330-340 amendment-appropriation requirements reference and the new division B 2101(d) identity. This EH addition is distinct from the eleven-authority current-2024 baseline list. Both exact versions remain traceable; baseline and voted amendments are not collapsed into one unqualified version. Existing annual transfer/source/medical grant/conditional child-service objects and all 70 application questions remain unchanged.

The chain therefore identifies four actual underlying requirements Acts, PL113-235, PL115-31, PL116-94 and PL117-328. Their material health-program/HHS/general requirements and application of the continuing direction with dated source scopes remain executable research. No final universal rider set, repeal/expiration of prior conditions, unrestricted medical spending, individual coverage, categorical fund allocation or full fund/package/domain acceptance is inferred from merely completing reference identities. Existing registered PL118-42 and PL118-158 originals are reused; a new full PL116-260 acquisition supplies division BB health context beyond the earlier DHS-only capture, without expanding that old governed source's extent. Private full PL117-328 remains unregistered pending material-condition review. State/migration/refugee assistance, supplementary/other DHS, exact counterparts, ordinary screenings and final whole-package comparison continue.
